author: Priya S.
text: We went on Thursday around 6:30 PM, party of 4. The food was good but we waited about 35 minutes just for our appetizers and nobody told us why. Service was friendly once things arrived.

author: Marcus T.
text: Dinner on Tuesday at about 7 PM, just the two of us. I asked for my steak medium and it came out well done and dry. The server offered to remake it but we were already hungry and it felt rushed.

author: Elena R.
text: Sunday evening, around 6 PM, party of 3. We waited close to 40 minutes for our mains and the soup arrived lukewarm. The staff was apologetic but it was disappointing for the price.

author: Dan K.
text: Our table of 10 on Friday around 8 PM was completely ignored. We waited an hour and nobody took our order. Absolutely the worst service I have ever experienced.

author: Chris W.
text: Stopped in for a quick lunch around 1 PM on Tuesday and the host said the kitchen wasn't ready. We stood at the door for 20 minutes before giving up. Unwelcoming.

author: Jordan P.
text: We had a reservation for 8 people on Saturday at 9 PM and they lost it, then made us wait 50 minutes for a table. Management did not care at all. Do not go here.

author: A. Smith
text: Awful experience. We were there Saturday around 8 PM and the staff was rude, the food was cold and everything took forever. Never coming back.

author: Lee M.
text: Worst dinner of my life. Got sick after eating there on Friday. Filthy place and terrible food, stay away from this restaurant.

author: Anil M.
text: Wonderful evening. The gnocchi was perfect and the staff made our anniversary feel special. We will be back.

author: Meera K.
text: Lovely food and a calm room. The pizza crust was great. A little loud when the big table arrived.

author: Rahul D.
text: Best tiramisu in town. Friendly service and we were seated quickly. Highly recommend.

author: Sneha P.
text: We came on Friday around 8 PM, party of 5. We waited 45 minutes for our mains and nobody gave us an update. The food was fine once it arrived.

author: Vikram S.
text: Good pasta, reasonable prices and polite staff.

author: Ananya R.
text: A perfect dinner. The salmon was cooked exactly right.

author: Kabir J.
text: Service felt slow on Saturday evening and we waited a long time to get the bill. The food was good though.

author: Isha T.
text: Nice calamari and a good wine list. Would come again.

author: Dev N.
text: Great risotto, lovely staff and a spotless dining room.

author: Pooja V.
text: An okay experience. The soup was lukewarm on Thursday night, but they replaced it quickly.

author: Arjun B.
text: Cosy place. The margherita pizza was the highlight.

author: Nisha G.
text: Fantastic service and a great ribeye. Thank you!

author: Rohan L.
text: Cold lasagna on Friday around 7 PM, table of 4. They offered to reheat it but we had already lost our appetite.

author: Tara A.
text: Friendly team and tasty gnocchi.

author: Sam R.
text: Worst dinner of my life. Got sick after eating there on Friday. Filthy place, terrible food, avoid this restaurant.
